verdict.rationale: No evidence in the pack discusses data retention policies, deletion controls, or user-facing settings to manage stored data/chat history/logs; RBAC evidence covers access permissions, not retention/deletion. This is an applicable axis for an AI product handling user code/data, but nothing documents retention windows or deletion controls, so it defaults to none. Missing for 10: data retention policy documentation, deletion/opt-out controls, data residency or export settings.
